_comment: On-hardware sysid + stabilization tune for the rig airframe. Captured from the live FC after diagnosing/fixing the throttle-up runaway and running roll system-ID. NOTHING on the FC is persisted across battery cycles, so re-apply these with tools/apply_tune.py after each boot. See memory onhw-sysid-phase0.
airframe: X-quad on a free-rotating rig (raised inertia). Motors: M1,M3 CW, M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned (no relative rotation).

motor_geometry._comment: Default X positions but spin INVERTED vs firmware default -> flips s_mix_yaw only (the firmware's default spin-sign was backwards for this build, causing yaw positive feedback). Keeps roll/pitch mix identical.

rate_pid._comment: controller=1 (rate). roll is sysid-TUNED; pitch is the stable pure-P SEED (kill the default ki=0.01 double-integrator oscillation) and still needs its own sysid; yaw is firmware default (stable once the geometry above is applied).

angle_pid._comment: controller=0 (angle). roll from sysid loop-shaping; pitch/yaw left at firmware default (not re-pushed).

identified_plant._comment: rate-loop plant omega/u = K/(s(tau s + 1)), fitted from one 0.5->12 Hz chirp at ~47% throttle.
